scripts.setup: npm --prefix web install && npm run setup:worker
scripts.setup:worker: PYTHON_BIN=$(command -v python3.13 || command -v python3.12) && test -n "$PYTHON_BIN" || (echo 'Python 3.12 or 3.13 is required for the worker' && exit 1); $PYTHON_BIN -m venv worker/venv && worker/venv/bin/pip install -r worker/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" INT TERM EXIT; npm run dev:web & npm run dev:worker & wait'
scripts.dev:worker: test -x worker/venv/bin/uvicorn || npm run setup:worker && cd worker && venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
